measurement_scope.codec_time: wall duration inside codec including preemption; not total MCU utilization
measurement_scope.endurance: three separate reflashed jobs; no uninterrupted 30-minute or multi-hour claim
measurement_scope.gpio_cpu: firmware processing basis points / 10000, per-run scope
measurement_scope.headroom: advertised retention and observed codec deadline-age margin; not a measured arbitrary-stall guarantee
measurement_scope.host_cpu: process CPU / wall time across START/STOP; one fully occupied core = 1
measurement_scope.limits: unstimulated inputs; no calibrated analog accuracy, external edge fidelity, power or ambient measurements
measurement_scope.short_writes: production USB transport and SDK host harness; no forced physical short write
measurement_scope.tails: v3 wire conservation excludes incomplete raw STOP tails, retained separately in ownership diagnostics
measurement_scope.usb: empty data ownership and active frame after STOP; status response itself can occupy response queue

scope: lifecycle, bounded host pressure and separate ten-minute endurance captures; no promotion
